title: Shadow Slave
premise: The Dream Realm bleeds into reality. Nightmare Creatures stalk the ruins of a broken world, and those who survive the First Nightmare return changed — marked by a Spell, bound to a fate they didn't choose. You live in this world.

lore.title: The Dream Realm
lore.text: A parallel dimension of nightmarish landscapes where Nightmare Creatures originate. Connected to the waking world through gates. Terrain shifts unpredictably — deserts become oceans, ruins rearrange. Time flows differently inside. The deeper you go, the more powerful and ancient the horrors become.

lore.title: The Forgotten Shore
lore.text: A desolate coastal region in the Dream Realm where many Sleepers awaken after their First Nightmare. Ruins of a fallen civilization line the cliffs. Survival here is measured in hours. The Dark Sea stretches endlessly beyond, hiding creatures of the deep.

lore.title: NQSC (National Quadrant Security Corps)
lore.text: Government military force responsible for defending humanity from Nightmare Creature incursions in the waking world. Operates Citadels — fortified outposts near Dream Gates. Recruits Awakened by contract or conscription. Brutal hierarchy, high casualty rates.

lore.title: The Spell
lore.text: Every human who survives their First Nightmare receives a Spell — a unique supernatural ability that defines their power. Spells manifest differently for each person and grow stronger through use. Some Spells are devastating weapons; others are subtle, strange, or seemingly useless.

lore.title: Soul Cores
lore.text: Killing Nightmare Creatures yields Soul Cores — crystallized essence used to strengthen an Awakened's body and soul. Cores come in ranks matching the creature's power. Absorbing them is painful and dangerous but necessary for survival and advancement.

lore.title: Memories
lore.text: Enchanted weapons, armor, and tools left behind by ancient beings in the Dream Realm. Each Memory has a name, a history, and unique abilities. They bond to their wielder and can be summoned at will. Rank determines power — from common tools to divine artifacts.

lore.title: Echoes
lore.text: Defeated Nightmare Creatures can sometimes be bound as Echoes — spectral servants that fight alongside their master. Echoes retain the creature's abilities but obey the Awakened who claimed them. Powerful Echoes are rare and coveted.

lore.title: Awakened Ranks
lore.text: Sleeper → Awakened → Ascended → Transcendent → Master → Saint → Sovereign. Each rank is exponentially more powerful. Saints can reshape reality. Sovereigns are living myths. Most Awakened never pass Ascended — the mortality rate is staggering.

lore.title: Nightmare Creatures
lore.text: Monstrous entities from the Dream Realm ranging from feral beasts to ancient intelligences. Classified by rank: Dormant, Awakened, Fallen, Corrupted, Great, and beyond. Higher ranks warp reality around them. Some speak. Some bargain. All kill.

lore.title: The First Nightmare
lore.text: A trial every human must face when they fall asleep for the first time after the Dream Realm's influence reaches them. Survivors awaken with a Spell and an Aspect. Most die. The nature of the Nightmare varies — some face monsters, others face impossible choices.

lore.title: The Citadel
lore.text: Massive fortified human settlements built near Dream Gates. Military-run, heavily defended, and always under threat. Life inside is regimented. Civilians work to support the Awakened. Outside the walls, Nightmare Creatures roam freely.

lore.title: The Dark Sea
lore.text: An endless ocean in the Dream Realm filled with leviathans and horrors beyond comprehension. No expedition has mapped it. Ships that sail too far don't return. The water itself is corrosive to the soul.

lore.title: The Great Clans
lore.text: Powerful Awakened families that control vast resources and political influence. Each clan hoards Memories, Echoes, and knowledge of the Dream Realm. Rivalries between clans are vicious. They recruit promising Sleepers aggressively.

lore.title: Sunny
lore.text: A young man from the outskirts who survived a brutal First Nightmare. His Spell is shadow-related — strange, versatile, and deeply tied to darkness. Cynical, pragmatic, and determined to survive at any cost. Not a hero by choice.

lore.title: Nephis
lore.text: Heir to one of the Great Clans. Radiantly beautiful with an iron will and terrifying combat ability. Her Aspect burns with blinding light. Born into power but carrying a burden that isolates her from everyone around her.

lore.title: Cassie
lore.text: A blind girl with a prophetic Spell — she sees the future in fragments. Quiet, unsettling, and far more dangerous than she appears. Her predictions are cryptic but never wrong. The weight of foresight has left her detached.

lore.title: Kai
lore.text: A healer with a gentle disposition and a Spell that mends flesh and bone. Kind to a fault in a world that punishes kindness. His value to any group is immeasurable — healers are rare and hunted by those who want to own them.

lore.title: Shadow God
lore.text: One of the ancient beings whose influence shaped the Dream Realm. Patron of shadows, secrets, and things hidden from light. Those marked by the Shadow God's lineage carry abilities tied to darkness. Worshipped and feared in equal measure.

lore.title: Aspects
lore.text: An Aspect is the core identity granted during the First Nightmare — a title and nature that shapes an Awakened's growth. Aspects determine what Memories and Echoes resonate with the wielder. Some Aspects are blessed. Others are cursed.

lore.title: The Waking World
lore.text: Earth, decades after the Dream Realm began bleeding through. Society fractured along class lines — the wealthy live in protected zones, the poor in outskirt slums near Dream Gates. Awakened are humanity's weapons and its greatest source of fear.

lore.title: Dream Gates
lore.text: Portals connecting the waking world to the Dream Realm. They appear without warning and cannot be closed. Nightmare Creatures pour through them. Citadels are built around stable Gates to contain the threat. Unstable Gates are catastrophes.
